investigation_notes.Description: The PowerShell script appears to be a DataVault backup pre-scan inventory executed by the NT SERVICE\DataBackupAgent service account; it enumerates large files on C: and writes logs and a CSV under C:\ProgramData\DataVault. There are no external IPs referenced, no process SHA256 available for reputation checks, and no historical alerts or events indicating malicious activity. Given the service account context, script behavior consistent with maintenance, and lack of reputation or historical indicators, this alert is assessed as Low Priority (LP).
